name: Fernhill Academy
rationale: --brand #0f766e is the theme color and drives links, buttons and nav; --spark #f97316 is the badge color, a distinct warm hue for decoration. Ink #0b1f1d and paper #f7faf9 come from the body styles. Headings use Lora and body uses DM Sans (both on Fontsource). Cards use a 14px radius.
